description: Example channel configuration for LiteLLM integration

user_key_channel.name: LiteLLM - User Key
user_key_channel.remark: LiteLLM integration - User's virtual key from xcity-home

service_key_channel.name: LiteLLM - Service Key
service_key_channel.remark: LiteLLM integration - Shared service key for internal tracking

multi_model_channel.name: LiteLLM - Multi-Provider
multi_model_channel.remark: Multi-provider access through LiteLLM with model mapping

test_channel.description: Tests the channel by making a request to the configured endpoint

sql_examples.create_channel_mysql: INSERT INTO channels (type, name, base_url, `key`, models, status, weight, created_time) VALUES (1, 'LiteLLM Router', 'https://tokenhub.xcity.one', 'sk-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx', 'gpt-4,gpt-3.5-turbo', 1, 100, UNIX_TIMESTAMP());
sql_examples.create_channel_postgres: INSERT INTO channels (type, name, base_url, key, models, status, weight, created_time) VALUES (1, 'LiteLLM Router', 'https://tokenhub.xcity.one', 'sk-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx', 'gpt-4,gpt-3.5-turbo', 1, 100, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW())::BIGINT);
sql_examples.create_channel_sqlite: INSERT INTO channels (type, name, base_url, key, models, status, weight, created_time) VALUES (1, 'LiteLLM Router', 'https://tokenhub.xcity.one', 'sk-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx', 'gpt-4,gpt-3.5-turbo', 1, 100, strftime('%s', 'now'));
sql_examples.update_existing_channels: UPDATE channels SET base_url = 'https://tokenhub.xcity.one' WHERE type = 1 AND (base_url = '' OR base_url = 'https://api.openai.com');
sql_examples.find_channels_to_migrate: SELECT id, name, type, base_url FROM channels WHERE type = 1 AND (base_url = '' OR base_url IS NULL OR base_url = 'https://api.openai.com');

test_request.description: Test request to verify LiteLLM integration
test_request.curl_command: curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/v1/chat/completions -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_XCT_NEW_API_TOKEN' -d '{"model": "gpt-3.5-turbo", "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}]}'

message.content: Hello! How can I assist you today?

check_logs.description: Verify requests are routed through LiteLLM

notes.channel_type: Type 1 = OpenAI. LiteLLM provides OpenAI-compatible API.
notes.base_url: Do not include /v1 suffix. The adapter will append the correct path.
notes.models: Comma-separated list of models available through this channel.
notes.key_format: LiteLLM virtual keys start with 'sk-' prefix.
notes.weight: Used for load balancing when multiple channels are available. Higher weight = higher priority.
notes.group: Used for organizing channels. 'default' is the default group.
notes.model_mapping: Optional JSON mapping to translate client model names to upstream model names.
